_comment: Trap entries (strategy/paywall-and-anti-scraping.md, layer 4). Invented products that exist only in the bulk card index the browser downloads, never on a page, in search or in the sitemap. If one shows up on another site, that site copied our data file. Keep this list private: it is in the repo, not in the build output. Their fnv1a hashes are in TRAP_HASHES in src/app/lib/demoSource.ts, which hides them from listings; scripts/prerender.ts refuses to build if the two disagree.
